records.generatedCopy: Cloudflare Browser Run recordings can now expose searchable logs, network details, HAR, and the final DOM after an AI browser-agent session closes. This guide separates replay masking from network evidence, then gives teams a target-aware export, redaction, retention, and release checklist so debugging artifacts do not become a secret dump.
